rationale: Dylan brings deep domain expertise in AI-powered career guidance and edtech GTM strategy, while Weiru's product marketing background at ByteDance—a company mastering consumer-AI and creator-economy platforms—offers complementary perspective on scaling consumer AI products. Both work in consumer-AI spaces where distribution and product-market fit are critical, and could exchange insights on positioning AI tools for end users versus enterprise adoption.
intro_message: Dylan Bryan, meet Weiru @Creative Community — you're both navigating consumer-AI product strategy from different angles (career guidance vs. creator platforms), and your GTM and product marketing expertise could surface useful patterns in how AI gets adopted at scale.
